name: studio-bundle
description: Entropy Studio's example addon bundle (terrain, water, FPS-RPG, tower defense, and more)
author: Alex Woodman <alexthegoodman@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/index.ts > dist/bundle.js
scripts.build-daw: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/daw_synth_addon.ts > dist/daw.js
scripts.build-fft-water: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/fft_water_addon.ts > dist/fft_water.js
scripts.build-game2d: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/games/game2d/index.ts > dist/game2d.js
scripts.build-level-editor-2d: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/games/level_editor_2d/index.ts > dist/level_editor_2d.js
scripts.build-node-graph: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/node_graph_addon.ts > dist/node_graph.js
scripts.build-html-ui-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/html_ui_demo_addon.ts > dist/html_ui_demo.js
scripts.build-fft-river: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/fft_river_water_addon.ts > dist/fft_river.js
scripts.build-light-hive: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/light_hive_addon.ts > dist/light_hive.js
scripts.build-mcp-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/mcp_tools_demo_addon.ts > dist/mcp_demo.js
scripts.build-video-export-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/video_export_demo_addon.ts > dist/video_export_demo.js
scripts.build-stylus-drawing: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/stylus_drawing_addon.ts > dist/stylus_drawing.js
scripts.build-keyframe-tracks-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/keyframe_tracks_demo_addon.ts > dist/keyframe_tracks_demo.js
scripts.build-doc-editor-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/doc_editor_demo_addon.ts > dist/doc_editor_demo.js
scripts.build-ml-graph-demo: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/ml_graph_demo_addon.ts > dist/ml_graph_demo.js
scripts.build-cc-manager: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/cc_manager_addon.ts > dist/cc_manager.js
scripts.build-canvas-surfaces: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/canvas_surfaces/canvas_surface_addon.ts > dist/canvas_surfaces.js
scripts.build-app-launcher: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/app_launcher_addon.ts > dist/app_launcher.js
scripts.build-guitar-tabs: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/tabs/tabs_addon.ts --output dist/guitar_tabs.js
scripts.build-terminal: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/terminal_addon.ts --output dist/terminal.js
scripts.build-creative-suite: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/creative_suite.ts --output dist/creative_suite.js
scripts.build-special-bundle: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/creative_suite.ts --output dist/special_bundle.js
scripts.build-studio-bundle: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/creative_suite.ts --output dist/special_bundle.js
scripts.build-sheet: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/sheet/sheet_addon.ts > dist/sheet.js
scripts.build-theme-gallery: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/theme_gallery_addon.ts > dist/theme_gallery.js
scripts.build-media-player: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/media_player_addon.ts --output dist/media_player.js
scripts.build-mesha: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/mesha/mesha_addon.ts --output dist/mesha.js
scripts.build-quadplanet: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/quadplanet/quadplanet_addon.ts --output dist/quadplanet.js && npm run build-house-worker
scripts.build-allegiance: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/games/allegiance/allegiance_addon.ts --output dist/allegiance.js && npm run build-house-worker
scripts.build-house-worker: npm run ensure-dist && deno bundle src/apps/quadplanet/qp_house_worker.ts --output dist/qp_house_worker.js
scripts.test:allegiance: vitest run tests/allegiance_world.test.ts tests/allegiance_street.test.ts tests/allegiance_screens.test.ts tests/allegiance_people.test.ts tests/allegiance_crowd.test.ts tests/allegiance_iteration1.test.ts tests/allegiance_upgrades.test.ts tests/allegiance_iteration2.test.ts tests/allegiance_visuals.test.ts
scripts.test:canvas: vitest run tests/canvas_surfaces.test.ts tests/canvas_paint_storage.test.ts tests/canvas_animation_bdd.test.ts tests/canvas_world_units.test.ts tests/canvas_world_bdd.test.ts --pool=threads
